answer: Latent Challenge Sampling. Each identity must periodically answer a freshly generated, context-specific challenge whose seed derives from its own past interactions, forming a private nebula of interdependent answers. Answers are checked against a trellis of cross-references only that identity's history could produce. A duplicated agent either copies answers and fails new challenges or maintains separate histories, costing full compute and memory per identity. Duplication becomes self-revealing when cloned answer patterns fail to align with each lineage's lotus of accumulated context.
